# SOIA

SOIA (soia-team) is a four-layer, local-first agent engineering family:

- **SoiaDeck**: Cross-device desktop AI workbench (local daemon, mobile Diff & permission approvals, encrypted NAT relay, local MLX router, and 19 coding agent adapters). Currently private, coming open source (`macOS arm64`).
- **Open Skills**: 47 public MIT skills anchored by the core marketplace repo `soia-open-skills` (`soia-meta` 4, `soia-pkm-vault` 27, `soia-dev` 9, `soia-cwork-office` 7). Supports Claude Code / Codex plugin mode, WorkBuddy desktop role-expert mode, and project-scoped `npx` installs.
- **SoiaCode (`si`)**: Lightweight single-binary Rust coding agent kernel & CLI (5 built-in tools, 10 governance mounts, 34 extensions). Currently in design stage (`0.0.1 M1`), MIT.
- **SOIA Runtime (Agent OS)**: Foundational Agent OS architecture (`System, Orchestration, Intelligence, Assurance`) under `github.com/soia-team/soia`.
